faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Porterchain logistics.

items.question: What areas does Porterchain serve?
items.answer: Porterchain operates across the Greater Toronto Area (GTA), including Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Oakville, and surrounding municipalities. We offer same-day and scheduled delivery throughout the region.

items.question: How quickly can I get a delivery?
items.answer: Most same-day deliveries can be booked within minutes. Once confirmed, a driver is typically assigned within 15–30 minutes depending on demand and location.

items.question: What types of items can I ship?
items.answer: We handle loose parcels, documents, furniture, marketplace purchases, gifts, and more. Hazardous materials and illegal items are not permitted.

items.question: What vehicle types are available?
items.answer: We offer Sedan, SUV, Pickup Truck, Cargo Van, High Roof Van, 16 ft Box Truck, and 20 ft Box Truck. All vehicles require a G Licence.

items.question: How does pricing work?
items.answer: Pricing is transparent and based on distance, vehicle type, weight, and urgency. Use our instant quote tool on the homepage for an estimate before booking.

items.question: Is real-time tracking available?
items.answer: Yes. Every delivery includes live GPS tracking, ETA updates, and push notifications. You can share tracking links with recipients.

items.question: What proof of delivery do you provide?
items.answer: We capture photo proof, digital signatures, and barcode scans at delivery. All proof is stored in your account.

items.question: Can I schedule a delivery for later?
items.answer: Yes. Choose a specific date and time window when booking. Same-day, next-day, and future scheduled deliveries are all supported.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept all major credit cards via Stripe for personal deliveries.

items.question: Is there a mobile app?
items.answer: Yes. The Porterchain Customer App is available on iOS and Android for booking, tracking, and managing deliveries on the go.

items.question: Do you offer furniture delivery?
items.answer: Yes. Our pickup trucks and cargo vans are ideal for furniture moves, marketplace pickups, and home deliveries.

items.question: How do I become a Porterchain driver?
items.answer: Visit our Driver page to apply. You'll need a valid G Licence, a qualifying vehicle, insurance, and a clean driving record.

items.question: Is customer support available 24/7?
items.answer: Yes. Our support team is available around the clock via phone, email, and in-app chat.

items.question: How is Porterchain different from other couriers?
items.answer: Porterchain combines Uber-like simplicity with reliable logistics — instant quotes, real-time tracking, and proof of delivery in one platform.

items.question: I need business or recurring logistics. Where do I go?
items.answer: Visit our Business page at porterchain.com/business to request a consultation. We offer recurring routes, wholesale distribution, merchant dashboards, API integration, and dedicated account support.
